title: Xanthe and the Escarpment
author: Astrid Galloway
blurb: Beatrix Brightwater, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
